Start Now With A Simple Remodeling steps

We have developed 6 steps to complete the work, ensuring streamlined planning and professional assistance that enhance your home's comfort and style, making the transformation truly enjoyable.

Get a Free Estimate

3 days

ABOUT US

Alexandria Kitchen and Bath Studio is an experienced design firm that will integrate innovative concepts into your home projects.

 

Although the basic function of a house is shelter, there is an art to transforming a collection of rooms into a home.  Making a kitchen “yours” means designing it exclusively for you.  It means understanding how you feel when you’re sipping that first morning cup, or enjoying a few scoops of Rocky Road at midnight.  It means creating a space that continuously welcomes you home.

 

While our primary focus is your kitchen and/or bathroom, we can also accommodate cabinetry needs throughout your home.  With a concern for function, we create alluring designs to transform your vision and wishes into reality and everyday life.

 

Our designers are certified National Kitchen and Bath Association members, and our installations are completed by our own experienced master carpenters and tradesmen.  The result is an efficient process that leads to timely and professional completion of projects.

 

Ranging from classic traditional to ultra-modern, and everything in-between, our variety of offerings from multiple manufacturers provide options for all tastes and styles.  Please come visit our Washington St. Alexandria, Virginia and let us help you turn your dreams into reality.

Tanya Dugan, CKD
Kitchen & Bath Designer

After 20 years in design and remodeling, Tanya Dugan has earned a well-deserved reputation for meticulous quality and professionalism. Tanya has completed hundreds of jobs throughout Maryland, Virginia and DC. She has been featured in national kitchen design publications and has had award winning projects. With her intuitive sense she captures her client’s vision while patiently guiding them through the process. Her highly functional designs focus on personal elements that make each project unique. Tanya is the mother of two wonderful adult children and loves to travel, cook, and entertain. You’ll be amazed as she works her creative magic on your space.

About Classic Kitchens

Creators of True Luxury Kitchens

Classic Kitchens of Virginia specializes in the design and installation of complete kitchens, baths, bars, casework and architectural millwork for all areas of the home.

Classic Kitchens of Virginia opened in 1995 with an unprecedented commitment to client satisfaction. We specialize in the design and implementation of unique, luxurious kitchens and baths; integrating high quality workmanship, state-of-the-art products, aesthetic form, and function.
Our Mission
Our designers work in partnership with our clients to create areas specifically suited to their tastes and needs. By providing all of the necessary components for a complete project, and by giving our clients a single point of accountability, we eliminate the frustration many expect when considering a renovation project. Our systematic approach to installation makes the construction process easier to manage and more comfortable for the homeowner.
Our Expectations
To Exceed the Expectations of Our Clients in Design, Installation and Quality of Products. To Include Our Clients as a Part of Our Team. To Maintain Professional Excellence in the Design and Execution of Each Project. To Provide the Best Return on Our Clients’ Investment

Why the Design Process Is the First Step in a Successful Home Remodel
Posted by: admin
March 19, 2026
Join Us For A Home Remodeling & Interior Design Brunch & Learn

Thinking about remodeling your home but aren’t sure where to begin? You’re not alone. Many homeowners know something in their home isn’t working, but they’re unsure what the first step should be.

That’s exactly why we’re hosting a Home Remodeling & Interior Design Brunch & Learn on Saturday, March 28th from 10 AM – 12:30 PM in the Creative Contracting Showroom.

During this relaxed and informative event, we’ll walk through the remodeling process, discuss timelines and expectations, and explain how the design phase shapes every successful project. You’ll also have the opportunity to ask questions, see materials and finishes up close, and learn how thoughtful planning can make remodeling a smoother and more enjoyable experience.

And of course, brunch bites will be served while you learn. RSVP here to save your spot.

Why Should You Attend This Informative Event?

If you’ve reached the point where something in your home just isn’t working, you’re already taking the first step. The issue may be urgent, or it may simply be a growing sense that everyday life could be easier and more enjoyable if your home better supported the way you live today. Perhaps your kitchen layout feels cramped, your bathroom no longer meets your needs, or your home’s flow doesn’t match the way your family uses the space.

These moments often spark the beginning of a remodeling journey. But before construction begins, the most important step is understanding the problem and exploring the right solution.

This is exactly where a design-build approach can make a meaningful difference. Our next event is designed to answer all your questions and give you the power to remodel your home with confidence.

Starting With Design Brings Clarity

Beginning with the design process allows you to slow down before making any major decisions. Instead of jumping directly into construction, the design phase creates space to fully understand what isn’t working in your home and what improvements could make the biggest impact.

This stage is where meaningful conversations happen. We discuss your goals, how your home currently functions, and what you envision for the future. During this phase, we evaluate how the space is currently used, identify opportunities for improvement, and begin shaping a design that reflects both your lifestyle and your aesthetic preferences.

A key part of this process is 3D design and visualization. As ideas begin to take shape, we create realistic 3D renderings that allow you to see the space before construction begins. These visualizations help bring the design to life—showing layout changes, cabinetry placement, lighting, materials, and how everything works together in the room.

Many homeowners find this stage incredibly valuable because it provides clarity. Rather than guessing what might work, you’re exploring thoughtful solutions guided by both design expertise and real-life experience and a clear visual plan for your future space. Explore this project to see how the design evolved from concept to reality.

The Advantage Of A Design-Build Approach

A key advantage of the design-build process is that design and construction expertise are working together from the very beginning. Instead of separating design and construction into different teams, both perspectives are integrated into a single collaborative process.

As ideas take shape, we develop clear visual concepts and 3D renderings that allow homeowners to see how the project will look before construction begins. At the same time, our construction team evaluates materials, structural requirements, timelines, and overall investment. This collaboration ensures that the design isn’t just beautiful, but also practical, buildable, and aligned with your goals.

For exterior projects, visualizing the transformation can make all the difference. Seeing the design ahead of time helps homeowners feel confident about major decisions like architectural details, materials, and how the news space will connect with the rest of the home. The exterior project shown here is a great example of how thoughtful design planning leads to a successful finished result.

Visualizing The Full Project Before Construction Begins

Throughout the design phase, plans are developed, layouts are refined, and materials and finishes are thoughtfully selected. This process allows homeowners to clearly visualize what their remodeled space will look like before construction begins.

Just as importantly, this planning stage allows everyone involved to understand the full scope of the project. By the time construction begins, the project has already been carefully planned, reducing surprises and helping the building phase run more smoothly.

Remodeling Starts With A Thoughtful Plan

A well-structured design process isn’t about committing to a remodel right away. Instead, it’s about gaining clarity, confidence, and a clear plan before deciding what comes next.

Remodeling your home—or even just a single space within it—is a significant decision. Taking the time to thoughtfully explore options ensures that the final design supports both your lifestyle and your long-term goals.

That’s why every project we take on begins with a thoughtful and well-planned design process.

If you’d like to learn more about how the process works and ask questions in a relaxed setting, we’d love to have you join us at our Home Remodeling & Interior Design Brunch & Learn on March 28th in the Creative Contracting Showroom. RSVP now to save your seat.

Our Story
Who knew such a dynamic team of remodeling contractors Austin can always count on, would begin their journey at such a young age. For the owners of D&R Custom Remodeling, Diego & Raquel Rodriguez, the journey started in high school. Although the couple knew of each other, they never really became friends. Until… 10 years after graduating high school, the couple’s paths’ crossed again and the rest is history! Diego & Raquel quickly realized that their values and desires in life were the same.

God, Family, Friends and Fun. The family enjoy traveling, skiing, camping, dancing and binge watching TV shows!  

Diego ran a 37-year-old family business which manufactured custom decorative glass products used in high-end retail and commercial spaces throughout the world. Raquel came from a corporate background involved in business development for a large magazine company out of NYC. Life was great! As their family grew, so did adventures and life experiences. 

Unfortunately, unforeseen circumstances followed – the magazine company went out of business and Raquel had to pivot, realizing the changes in NYC leading up to the pandemic, the couple decided life changes were necessary. After being in New York their entire lives, they decided to relocate to a state that was more in line with their values – a state that felt like home even though they were new. A place where they could raise their children without the worry of rising crime. A place where they can explore and be… kids. So sight unseen – and viola – they moved to Texas! Who knew it wasn’t just flat lands with tumble weeds everywhere but there are cities, lakes, parks and oceans with the nicest people ever!

Meanwhile, Diego traveled back and forth to NYC from Austin to continue to run the family business with the plan to eventually move permanently to Texas to join the family. He felt torn because of course he missed family and friends, but at the same time felt at home in Austin. Eventually, the couple sold the decorative glass products business. Diego and Raquel then decided to open a new business to support their family. With decades of experience dealing with architects and designers, along with the knowledge of construction, D&R Custom Remodeling was born! Acknowledging their blessings and skilled craftsmanship, experience, and an extensive knowledge in remodeling so many projects, they found a love of custom remodeling entirely from full home renovations to upscale kitchens. This is when D&R became the remodeling contractors Austin can always depend on.

OUR PURPOSE: 

The heart and joy of this company comes from working with clients to create beautiful things, earning our reputation as premiere remodeling contractors Austin style!

With a history taking one dimensional drawings and turning them into three dimensional pieces of art on glass, to now taking clients’ ideas, dreams, and visions and making them a reality – each project is built with a story where relationships last, and memories are made.  

 

Our Process
Step 1: Consultation

Let’s dive into what your needs and wants are. If you have a vision for this project that’s great! If you don’t, that’s ok too … we’ll help get you there. We’ll be taking measurements to be able to start on our next steps.

Step 2: Estimate

Next, you will receive a preliminary estimate. With this starting point we can narrow in on your budget and scope of the work. Our consultations and estimates are complimentary.

Step 3: Approval

Once the final plans are approved and the estimate is finalized, the invoice is created and a deposit is collected. Then materials are ordered, and a start date will be set!

Step 4: Start

Our team manages every detail of work from demo to the final punch list walk-through. Renovations can be stressful on homeowners, so we minimize this stress with frequent communication and check-ins.

Step 5: Project Management

 We communicate daily and send weekly updates to all our clients. As changes happen, or any unforeseen things pop up, we handle it with ease and care.

Step 6: Finish

Once the items on the final punch list walk-through are completed, you can completely enjoy your kitchen, bathroom or entire house!

Our Quality Guarantee

We promise you will love your new kitchen and bath built by the dedicated team of remodeling contractors Austin loves and trusts!
We only produce quality work and guarantee our craftsmanship for 1 year, plus manufacturer warranties.

Design Build
The key to a successful remodel

Teamwork- The advantage of being a team when tackling any project in life is well known.  Design Build leverages the relationship amongst the Design Team, Contractor and client to work as a team to achieve a successful project that meets or exceeds the client’s expectations.  One of the many advantages of the design build process is when design, budget, or construction issues arise, everyone can quickly roll up their sleeves and work towards the most advantageous solution.

​

Total Accountability- The Design Build contractor is accountable for the entire project, quality of design, total costs, speed of execution, and final results.  By having all decisions controlled centrally, the likelihood of costly expenses or delays can be greatly reduced.  When the same team that designs the project builds the project, more attention to detail is given and costs are more clearly outlined earlier in the process, thus allowing for a higher level of transparency by all parties.  Clients are empowered to make more cost-effective decisions and avoid costly change orders down the road.

​

Continuity- Being involved from beginning to end allows for a higher level of efficiency and effectiveness.  This is compounded by having a dedicated project manager.  The project manager is the conduit between inhouse management, designers, vendors, subcontractors, and client.  Leveraging the Design Build approach in planning is then carried into the execution by a dedicated project manager who is intimately familiar with all aspects of the project.

​

Expertise- Another advantage of the Design Build approach is the experienced relationship between designer/architect and builder.  By being able to integrate both aspects from the beginning of a project, real time solutions can be implemented to avoid delays, unnecessary expenses, and miscommunication.  An experienced builder can recognize potential difficulties during a part of the design and provide input to modify design as needed to stay on budget.

​

Professional Guides- The construction industry is riddled with stories about out-of-control budgets and extended project timelines.  Design Build can nearly eliminate these issues because the relationship between builder and client is based on trust and advocacy for the client’s best interests. This always leads to the project being guided to the best possible outcome by a collaborative effort of design team, builder, and client.

 

Owner Involvement- Design Build functions best when there is an appropriate amount of owner involvement throughout the process.  This ensures that the client’s goals are being accomplished once established during discovery and design.  Owners can be presented with options on finishes, product selections, and even sub-contractor selection to balance budget requirements with desired outcome. 

 

Collaboration- Unlike traditional models where the owner/client can have different agreements with multiple parties, Design Build offers one master agreement between client and Design Build firm.  The Design Build firm oversees responsibility for all aspects of job execution and planning.  This allows a greater level of control and transparency for the client.  The heart of the relationship is based on collaboration and trust between client and contractor.  This is not always the case in a more traditional agreement.

 

Open, Honest, and Frequent Communication- The Design Build process outlines costs in a very transparent manner so the client can make informed decisions.  Design Build avoids telling clients what they want to hear, but more importantly what they need to hear.  Through clear communication, a realistic budget can be established early in the process and becomes the driving force for making key decisions and agreements for the entire project.

​

Time Management- Having all planning and implementation controlled by one entity, allows for the most efficient schedule management.  It allows for “long sightedness” empowering the project management team to recognize potential obstacles early on and implement solutions effectively.  All key players are involved and make decisions to avoid moving backwards.  Design Build can adapt quickly and respond in real time.  This helps to avoid potential costly change orders and delays.

If you’re considering remodeling your home in Venice or Southwest Florida, you’re likely balancing excitement with hesitation. At Girka Design Build, we exist to remove uncertainty from remodeling.
 

For more than 15 years, we’ve specialized in design-build home remodeling, managing projects from the first conversation through final completion. Our reputation is built on disciplined project management, clear communication, clean jobsites, and craftsmanship that holds up—not shortcuts, chaos, or guesswork.


This page is designed to be the most complete and honest resource for home
remodeling in Venice, FL. Whether you’re planning a bathroom remodel or a full home renovation, you’ll find straightforward guidance on process, pricing, timelines, and how to choose the right partner.


Service Areas: Venice, Nokomis, Sarasota, Osprey, North Port & surrounding Southwest Florida communities

Why Design-Build Remodeling Matters in
Southwest Florida

Many remodeling problems don’t start on the jobsite—they start long before construction begins. In a traditional remodel, design and construction are handled separately. Plans are
created without real-time pricing input, contractors bid incomplete scopes, and once
work begins, miscommunication leads to delays, change orders, and frustration.


Design-build remodeling solves this by unifying planning, budgeting, and construction
under one accountable team.


With Girka Design Build:

 Design decisions are aligned with real construction costs

 Budgets are clarified early—not after demolition

 Scheduling and trade coordination are managed proactively

 One team is responsible for results from start to finish

​

In Southwest Florida, where permitting requirements, inspections, moisture control,
hurricane codes, and material lead times are critical, this level of coordination isn’t
optional—it’s essential.

Home Remodeling Services We Specialize In

We focus on projects where experience, organization, and attention to detail make the biggest difference.

Bathroom Remodeling

Bathrooms combine plumbing, waterproofing, electrical, tile, and finishes into one highly technical space. Poor planning here leads to long-term issues.
We remodel:

 Primary bathrooms

 Guest and hallway bathrooms

 Aging-in-place and accessibility upgrades

 Custom showers, tilework, and storage solutions


Typical Investment Range: $15,000 – $80,000+
Our process emphasizes proper waterproofing, thoughtful layouts, and materials that

Kitchen Remodeling

Kitchen remodels are often the most complex projects in a home, involving cabinetry,
appliances, lighting, structural considerations, and workflow.


Our kitchen remodeling services include:

 Layout reconfiguration and space planning

 Structural modifications

 Cabinetry design and coordination

 Appliance and fixture planning

 Electrical, lighting, and ventilation upgrades

 

Typical Investment Range: $30,000 – $120,000+
Successful kitchens aren’t just beautiful—they’re planned around how the space is
actually used.

Remodeling Costs and Why 
Pricing Varies

One of the most common questions homeowners ask is:
“Why does remodeling cost so much?”

The reality is that pricing is driven by:

 Scope of work

 Material selections

 Structural complexity

About HBRE

HBRE provides design-build services catering primarily to the remodeling needs of homeowners throughout the Twin Cities metropolitan area.

Home remodeling and construction can be both intimidating and challenging. If you are a homeowner, know that we are prepared to lead you through the experience, navigating your project’s custom twists and turns – together. Rest assured that while you may be new to home building and remodeling, we are not. Having successfully completed several hundred projects, HBRE has compiled a substantial amount of design-build remodel experience over the years. We are continuously striving to refine our craft, improve our processes, and optimize our customer value proposition. Additionally, it is our constant desire to do well by the customers who trust us with their homes and, in part, lives. After all, the homes we live in can impact our individual, family, and financial well-being for many years to come. We know this, see it in our own lives and homes and, as such, take our responsibilities seriously.

HBRE’s simple objectives as a company are to be transparent, honest, available, accountable, and profitable. We desire to surround ourselves with customers, employees, suppliers, and subcontractors who share in these values. If you foresee yourself in any one of these partner roles and desire to talk about it further, please let us know. Be aware that to either work with or for HBRE is to engage in a partnership. Our relationship begins as soon as you contact us and, if we mutually agree to partner, we hope to build upon it every day thereafter.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Process.

Home remodeling is complicated. Although the work is very familiar, the circumstances are always new. By nature, all projects are custom. Your design preferences, your priorities, your budget, your home…everything is unique to you.

HBRE’s objective is that, together, we find satisfaction in both the results and each step along the way. So, amid the complexity and custom requirements, we follow a simple process:

In-Home Consultation

The discussions have to start at some point so, we might as well meet at the job site (your home). We’ll discuss what it is you want to accomplish. HBRE will get a chance to learn a little about you. You’ll get a chance to learn a little about us.

HBRE creates a price offer to design your project based upon what we have discussed. The larger the project, the more time we will spend together during the Design Engagement discussing concepts, creating drawings, and making decisions. 

Design Contract
Design Engagement

We measure the existing spaces and create the drawings. Then we discuss concepts and layouts. Once we land on a concept layout that you love we further focus on the materials, fixtures and finishes (i.e. selections) that will fill the spaces.

At the end of Design Engagement you are presented with a proposal package consisting of an Estimate, Drawings and the Estimate-referencing Allowance-based bids gathered from suppliers and subcontractors. If the offer is acceptable, we move to contract.

Build Contract
Production Planning

Once you have formally agreed to the contract we spend the following few weeks to place material orders, line-up subcontractors and build-out the job schedule. The availability of the materials and people required to complete the job determines the job schedule.

This is the construction phase where we tear it down as necessary and then build it backup anew. We demo. We build. We coordinate. As we progress, your remodel design comes to life before our eyes.

Jupiter, Florida is a sought-after coastal community in northern Palm Beach County known for its waterfront lifestyle, excellent schools, and relaxed atmosphere. With a cost of living that reflects its desirable location, Jupiter attracts families and retirees alike. The area experiences seasonal storm activity, including strong winds and heavy rain during hurricane season, which makes durable home construction and storm-rated materials essential for homeowners. Florida's strict coastal building codes exist for good reason here, and every remodeling project should account for these conditions, making it important to hire licensed professionals who strive for lasting results.

Jupiter offers residents and visitors some truly memorable attractions. The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse and Museum is a historic landmark worth visiting, while Dubois Park provides beautiful waterfront access for families. Jonathan Dickinson State Park offers miles of trails and river kayaking. Roger Dean Chevrolet Stadium brings spring training baseball to the area, and Blowing Rocks Preserve showcases one of the most dramatic stretches of Atlantic coastline in South Florida. Harbourside Place adds shopping, dining, and entertainment along the Intracoastal Waterway.

ABOUT US

Curio was originally from a little town near Perugia, Italy. He attended the Institute Technico Industriale where he studied architecture and cabinetmaking. After immigrating to the USA he went on to build custom furniture by hand in the family home. Many pieces are still being used some forty years later, including his first custom kitchen crafted at the age of 17.

On February 4th, 1974 Kitchens by Curio was started by Curio Nataloni in Ludlow, MA. During his time with the Ludlow showroom -- in which he installed his projects in the morning and met with his clients in the afternoon -- he established an excellent reputation for his new kitchen designs and quality installations. During the course of that time he also educated himself through the NKBA and attended kitchen and bath design courses at the University of Notre Dame earning his CKD (Certified Kitchen Designer) qualification.

In the course of his career Curio has won many National and International awards. Most notably he is a TWO time winner of the International Maytag & Wilson-Art CKD competition. The winning projects have been featured at several National Home shows as well as on the front cover of “House Beautiful” -- one of which was called “Kitchen of the Year”. After winning the competition in 1993, Curio was asked to be a judge in the 1994 competition! Curio is also an active member in the NKBA and the HBA and was also the former president of the Mass State Home Builders Association from 1999-2000.

In 1984, after 10 years in Ludlow, Curio moved his showroom to Springfield, MA. At that time, Frank Nataloni graduated from the University of North Carolina, Greensboro and joined the firm full-time. Having spent many years working part-time with Curio while going through school, it was an easy adjustment. He started working “in the field,” where he gained in-depth knowledge of craftsmanship, working under Curio’s wing.

Frank has also taken many courses through the NKBA, BHA and UMASS, and is a former adjunct professor at Bay Path University, in Longmeadow MA, where he taught Kitchen Design. Frank became the second person in the state of Massachusetts to be a Certified Bathroom Designer. His work has been featured in many publications. “Green” projects are nothing new to Frank, who has completed a number of them, including one for an environmentally ill client where only steel cabinets could be used. Frank has been involved in professional organizations including NKBA, HBA-Remodelers Council, BNI, The FBC, as well as the former Board Chair of the non-profit Revitalize CDC, which helped seniors, veterans, and people with disabilities stay in their homes by way of accommodating renovations.

However, Frank’s most esteemed designation lies within his exclusivity as the only person in Western Massachusetts that holds both the Certified Kitchen Designer (CKD) and Certified Bath Designer (CBD) designations, from both associations.

At Made New Home Services, we pride ourselves on being more than just a remodeling company – we are your partners in turning your aspirations into reality. Founded with a vision to reimagine what it means to remodel; Made New Home Services has created an experience that marries the artistry of craftsmanship with the clarity of communication.

With years of experience under our belt, we have honed our skills and expertise, delivering exceptional remodeling solutions that you and your loved ones can enjoy for years to come. Quality Guarantee 

At Made New Home Services, we believe that everyone deserves a safe and beautiful home. We are a family-owned business that provides quality remodeling services with an emphasis on customer satisfaction. We are insured and licensed, so you can trust that your home is in good hands.

 

We are dedicated to helping you turn your home into a space that you can be proud of. Whether you need small repairs or large-scale renovations, our team of experts is here to make your dream home a reality.

Our Story

Welcome — We're glad you’re here.
 

I’m Matt, Owner of Made New Home Services, LLC.
 

My journey in construction began early, working alongside my father and grandfather in their home services businesses. Even then, I was drawn to the process of restoring and transforming homes—bringing new life to spaces that needed it most.
 

Since officially starting my career in 2016, I’ve had the opportunity to grow through a range of experiences in the residential construction industry. Each step has shaped my approach and deepened my commitment to craftsmanship, integrity, and continual improvement.
 

In 2021, my wife Abby and I launched Made New Home Services with a shared vision: to raise the standard for remodeling experiences in the Kansas City area. While I lead our production and operations, Abby plays an integral role in the business—supporting our brand, marketing, and client communications. Together, we’re focused on delivering a remodeling process that is both professional and personal.
 

From your first inquiry to the final walkthrough, our promise is to remain transparent, communicative, and fully committed to your project’s success.

Thank you for being here—and for supporting a business built on passion, family values, and a love for making homes feel new again.

About Peachline Bath & Design

Peachline Bath & Design is a locally owned and operated bathroom remodeling company serving North Atlanta including Marietta, Smyrna, Woodstock, Kennesaw, Cumming, Canton and beyond. Our specialized design and construction team is insured and handles all permitting, and we’re dedicated to creating beautiful, functional spaces.

Our Story

We got our start in 2023 fixing and flipping houses. The bathrooms we renovated quickly became the talk of those homes, earning us rave reviews from buyers who loved our unique approach to bath design. That encouragement inspired us to focus on bathroom renovations and thoughtfully finished interiors, bringing together a dedicated design team and skilled construction crew under one roof.

Today Peachline Bath & Design elevates bathrooms and interiors across North Atlanta. We pair creative vision with meticulous craftsmanship to transform everyday routines into relaxing rituals. We bring bathroom remodeling, cabinets, closets, painting, and glass together through a coordinated turnkey approach. Our mission is to refine spaces and redefine comfort, and we handle every step – from concept through permitting to final clean‑up – so you can enjoy the process as much as the result.

Where It All Started... 

Stevens Kitchens 

In the late 90s, our owner, Steve, started out in the cabinet industry as a service technician for a kitchen cabinet company. This later led to him advancing and becoming an actual installer...

In 2003, Stevens Kitchens Inc. was born! Steve was still an installer, but opened his own business and laid the foundation for what is now, Stevens Kitchens...

Two years later, in 2005, Stevens Kitchens' first showroom was open for browsing. 

Fast forward! After obtaining his General Contractor License in 2015, Steve opened our beautiful, current  showroom on Broadway Street!

When the lot has no room to build out, the way to add space is up. Sun Shore Construction builds second-story additions across Greater Boston — full second floors on ranch houses, partial additions over one wing, and new rooms over an existing garage. Plans are drawn by a licensed architect or designer (you are welcome to bring your own); we build to those plans and handle the permitting. Licensed and fully insured; proof available on request.

Common second-story projects
Second story on a ranch house — the classic way to turn a one-level home into a two-level home with bedrooms upstairs.
Partial second story — adding a master suite or two bedrooms over part of the house instead of the whole footprint.
Second story over a garage — new living space on top of an existing attached garage.
Three questions we ask first
When was the house built? Older foundations and framing may need reinforcing before they can carry a new floor.
What goes upstairs? Bedrooms only, or bathrooms and a master suite too — that decides plumbing and the size of the new floor.
Can you stay in the house during the work? Part of the roof comes off, so you may need to stay elsewhere for part of the project. We talk this through on the site visit.
Will my town allow it? Zoning comes first

Before anything is drawn, we check the rules that decide what you can build on your lot: setbacks from your property lines, lot coverage, and height limits. If a design does not fit the zoning rules as written, some towns allow it with a special permit or variance from the town’s zoning board. That adds steps, so we tell you early.

Height limits matter most for a second story; we check them before your architect starts drawing.

Permits and inspections — we handle them

An addition needs a building permit, and the work is inspected at each stage. We pull the building permit and coordinate inspections with your town. Electrical and plumbing permits are pulled by the licensed electricians and plumbers we hire for your project — and because we manage the whole job, every permit is our responsibility, not yours.

What affects the cost of a second-story addition?

Every house is different, so we never quote a price sight-unseen. The main factors: how much of the footprint gets a second floor, whether the foundation and first-floor framing need reinforcing, the number of bathrooms upstairs, the new stair, heating and cooling for the new floor, and matching the roofline and siding to the rest of the house. After a site visit we give you a free written estimate, itemized so you can see what is included.

FAQ
Can my ranch house support a second floor?

It depends on the foundation and framing. That is a structural question answered by your design team before construction starts, not a guess.

Is a second story better than building out?

If your lot is tight or setbacks leave no room, going up is usually the only option. If you have room, building out can be simpler. We look at both on the site visit.

Do you handle the permits?

Yes — see “Permits and inspections” above.

How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Alpharetta?
+

How Much Does a Kitchen Remodel Cost in Alpharetta, GA?

Planning a kitchen renovation in North Atlanta? We break down real costs by project scope — from a simple cabinet refresh to a full gut remodel — so you can budget with confidence.

A cabinet refresh — new doors, hardware, and a fresh coat of paint — typically runs $4,000–$9,000. Moving up to semi-custom cabinetry with new countertops puts you in the $15,000–$35,000 range. A full gut renovation with custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, a kitchen island, and new appliances commonly falls between $45,000 and $85,000 in the Alpharetta market.

The biggest cost drivers are cabinetry (30–40% of budget), countertop material, and whether you're moving plumbing or walls. Quartz runs $60–$120 per sq ft installed; marble starts higher. Labor in North Atlanta typically accounts for 35–45% of total project cost.

Cabinet refresh: $4,000 – $9,000
Mid-range remodel: $15,000 – $35,000

Custom luxury build: $90,000+

Shaker vs. Flat-Panel Cabinets: Which Is Right for Your Milton Home?

Cabinet style sets the entire tone of your kitchen. We compare the two most popular styles side by side — cost, durability, maintenance, and which pairs best with different home designs.

Shaker cabinets feature a recessed center panel with a simple frame — clean, timeless, and versatile. They work beautifully in traditional, transitional, and even modern farmhouse kitchens. Cost-wise, shaker doors add roughly 10–15% over slab pricing but hold their resale appeal extremely well.

Flat-panel (slab) cabinets have no frame detailing — just a smooth, continuous surface. They read as contemporary and minimalist, require less cleaning around grooves, and pair perfectly with integrated handles or push-to-open hardware.

Shaker: best for transitional & traditional homes
Flat-panel: best for modern & contemporary designs
Shaker cleans slightly more effort (grooves collect dust)
Both available in painted, stained, and thermofoil finishes

Mason or Ferdy will talk through this with you during your free in-home estimate, alongside the finishes and countertop you're considering.

5 Ways to Make a Small Bathroom Feel Larger Without Knocking Down Walls

Limited square footage doesn't mean limited style. Our designers share five proven techniques — from large-format tile to frameless mirrors — that visually expand any bathroom.

Large-format tile: 24×24" or 24×48" porcelain with minimal grout lines eliminates the visual "chopping" effect of small tiles and makes floors read as one continuous surface.
Frameless mirrors: A full-width frameless mirror doubles the perceived depth of the room — the single most impactful change for under $500.
Curbless shower: Removing the shower curb and extending tile continuously from floor to wall eliminates visual barriers and creates a seamless, open feel.
Wall-mounted vanity: Floating the vanity off the floor reveals the floor beneath, which tricks the eye into reading the room as larger and keeps cleaning easier.
Consistent color palette: Using the same tile on floors and walls (or close tonal variations) removes boundaries and unifies the space visually.

We've applied all five of these in bathrooms as small as 40 sq ft across North Atlanta — the transformations are remarkable. Reach out for a free consultation and we'll walk you through what's achievable in your space.

Why White Kitchens Still Reign Supreme in Sandy Springs & Cumming Homes?

White kitchens have stood the test of time — and for good reason. We explore why this classic palette continues to dominate North Atlanta renovations and how to keep it feeling fresh.

Trends come and go — emerald green islands, navy lowers, bold terracotta — but white kitchens remain the top choice for Sandy Springs and Cumming homeowners year after year. Why? Resale value, versatility, and light.

White reflects natural light better than any other color, making kitchens feel larger and more inviting. It also provides a neutral canvas that lets countertops, backsplash, and hardware become the design statement — which means the kitchen evolves with you without a full renovation every time tastes change.

White kitchens command higher resale prices in North Atlanta
Pair with warm wood accents to avoid a sterile look
Off-white and warm white tones (vs. stark white) age more gracefully
Matte or lightly textured finishes hide fingerprints better than high-gloss

The key is in the details: the right undertone, the right sheen, and the right countertop pairing. Our designers have executed dozens of white kitchens across Sandy Springs, Cumming, and Roswell — each one distinct, none of them boring.

Renovating your kitchen or bathroom is one of the smartest investments a homeowner can make. We break down exactly how these upgrades boost your home's value in the Johns Creek, Marietta & Duluth market.

In the Johns Creek, Marietta & Duluth market, kitchen and bathroom renovations consistently rank as the top two upgrades for home value — and when done right, they deliver returns that go far beyond the numbers.

Bathroom renovations — particularly master bath upgrades — recoup 55–75% and are a major deciding factor for buyers in the $500K+ segment. Updated tile, frameless glass showers, and modern vanities signal quality and can justify a significantly higher listing price.

Kitchen & bath together: strongest combined ROI and buyer appeal
Updated finishes and fixtures: fastest value boost per dollar spent
Mid-range renovations consistently outperform luxury spend on ROI
Both spaces increase appraisal value in Johns Creek, Marietta & Duluth zip codes

OUR PROCESS

A clearer way to remodel your kitchen or bathroom.

Remodeling can feel overwhelming when design, products, contractors, timelines, and decisions are all separate. Southern Materials Company brings those pieces together with a guided process built around your home, your priorities, and your final result.

View the Full Process
Start a Conversation
1
Consult

Talk through your goals, style, needs, budget, timeline, and what is not working in the space today.

5
Coordinate
